## Summary

Elmhurst Clinics LLP (policy CC-1666): fire damage in a neighbouring unit to a label printer and a barcode scanner at a storage unit on Mill Road. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 3,254 dollars.

## Facts

Elmhurst Clinics LLP reported the loss on 21 June 2026 under policy CC-1666 [notice of loss]. The loss is fire damage in a neighbouring unit [notice of loss]. It occurred at a storage unit on Mill Road [notice of loss]. The items are a label printer and a barcode scanner [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 23 June 2026 under reference IR/2026/4234 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The label printer is invoiced by Beacon Office Supply at 1,666 dollars [invoice 1]. The barcode scanner is invoiced by Crane & Sons Electronics at 1,588 dollars [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the scheduled premises, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft, fire, storm or escape of water [policy]. Fire is a named cause of loss in clause 4.2 [policy], and the loss is fire damage [notice of loss], [incident report].

The file does not include the policy schedule, and it does not say in terms whether the storage unit is a scheduled premises or was in the insured's custody [policy], [notice of loss]. This acceptance is on the basis that the items were in the insured's custody at the storage unit, and that point should be confirmed against the schedule.

- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged, so there is no theft of unattended portable equipment [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is fire damage, not gradual deterioration [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the premises or custody point above against the schedule.

## Reserve

The reserve is 3,254 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (1,666 dollars and 1,588 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts the 250 dollar excess only where the policy schedule applies one, and none is shown in the file, so no excess is deducted [policy].
